source.name: Warosu Database Backup 2023-03-15
source.short-desc: Database backup of warosu.org on 2023-03-15 in mysqldump (SQL statements) format
source.capture:
12 per-board mysqldumps as .sql.zst (3, biz, cgl, ck, diy, fa, ic, jp, lit, sci, vr, vt). The IA item lists them loose; an all-files zip of the same content also exists, so prepare handles either starting point. Emits one INSERT statement per row, unlike the 2025-08-15 dump's extended inserts -- so `grep -c '^INSERT INTO'` IS a valid row count here and is NOT on that one, and file sizes are not comparable between the two.

DO NOT DROP THIS IN FAVOUR OF 2025-08-15. Diffed distinct `num` per board across both dumps (2026-08-03, full scan of all 12 boards on both sides, not sampled): 2025 is NOT a superset. This dump holds 178,739 real posts that 2025 lacks -- jp 116,122, lit 42,661, sci 18,630, fa 1,326; the other eight boards lose nothing. Verified by sampling 200 of the jp-only numbers, all of which resolve to real rows in the store dated 2008-03 through 2023-03. Same attrition class as the documented 2021 /g/ + /tg/ removal, but partial and therefore invisible at board level: all 12 boards still appear in 2025.

195,196,863 rows total, of which 386,693 are ghost posts (subnum != 0, replies made on warosu itself rather than 4chan) and are skipped on ingest. 93% of those are on /jp/ (359,697). Every ghost's `num` is shared with a real subnum=0 post -- Fuuka assigns ghosts the thread's last real post number -- so distinct(num) equals the real-post count, and a distinct-num diff is ghost-free by construction.

prepare.name: unpack the zip, if the item was fetched in that form
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && if [ -z "$(ls out/*.sql 2>/dev/null)" ] && ! ls extracted/*.sql.zst extracted/*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.sql.zst' -not -path './extracted/*' -print -quit)" ]; then z=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.zip' -print -quit); [ -n "$z" ] && 7z x -aos -o./extracted "$z"; fi; true

prepare.name: decompress the zstd per-board dumps
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && find . -name '*.sql.zst' -not -path './out/*' | while read -r f; do b=$(basename "${f%.zst}"); [ -e "extracted/$b" ] || [ -e "out/$b" ] || unzstd -q -o "extracted/$b" "$f"; done

prepare.name: stage the .sql dumps for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && find extracted -name '*.sql' -exec sh -c 'cp -al "$1" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$1" out/' _ {} ';'
